international.title: Burnham should ‘move on’ from Brexit, says Theresa May, as critics hit out over closer EU ties – UK politics live
international.summary: Issue dominates Sunday broadcast round following Friday’s deals on trade and youth mobility Theresa May ‘aghast’ at Andy Burnham’s talk about rejoining EU The Tories and Reform have made the argument this morning that the new food deal is “bad” for British farmers, because they will be subject to EU rules and standards. They say more than 90% of British farmers currently don’t export to the EU- so why should Britain have to cede that control over standards? What we’re saying is that actually, yes, we should integrate into the market where for the first time, we’ll be able to shape decisions agreed to in the EU. Continue reading...
